I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes and sent Dana the list in our direct message:

- **#PD-4492**, from Moss's Sunday prep note for Ruth dated 5 Oct 2025 (`teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md`). Thea Ramaswell filed it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at the Eau Claire yard weren't getting text messages with their dock bay at the gatehouse kiosk. Support fixed it that evening, and Thea confirmed the fix the next day.
- **#4419**, from Moss's North cheat sheet (`teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners at Door 14 weren't reading trailer tags. It was passed to second-level support for scanner testing. The cheat sheet isn't dated, so I couldn't say when the ticket was raised.

I also told Dana what I left out and why:
- **#4409, #4412 and FR-882** appear in Moss's Central handoff digest, but they belong to Marrow accounts.
- **Two other Moss notes** (the 9/14 pipeline digest and the 3/23 renewal note) mention Quarrendon Freight Lines but give no ticket numbers.
- **Quarendon Freightways** is a different company and not a customer, so I didn't include anything about it.

All of Moss's notes are public files. Ticket numbers are account details, not money terms, so Dana can put them in the weekly notes and no approval was needed. I only checked Moss's notes in the shared files, not Moss's channel messages.
